pairs: Qui quasi flos egreditur et conteritur,
He comes forth like a flower, and is crushed,
and he flees, as if a shadow,
et numquam in eodem statu permanet.
and never remains in the same state.
Et dignum ducis super hujuscemodi aperire oculos tuos,
And do you consider it fitting to look down with your eyes on someone in this way
et adducere eum tecum in judicium?
and to lead him into judgment with you?
Quis potest facere mundum de immundo conceptum semine?
Who can make him clean who is conceived of unclean seed?
Are you not the only one who can?
The days of man are short,
numerus mensium ejus apud te est:
and the number of his months is with you;
like that of the hired hand.
Si senuerit in terra radix ejus,
If its roots grow old in the earth,
et in pulvere emortuus fuerit truncus illius,
and its trunk passes into dust,
it will sprout and bring forth leaves,
as when it had first been planted.
Homo vero cum mortuus fuerit, et nudatus, atque consumptus, ubi, quæso, est?
Truly, when a man dies, and has been left unprotected, and has decayed, I ask you where is he?
Quomodo si recedant aquæ de mari,
It is as if the waters had receded from the sea
and an emptied river had dried up;
when a man is fallen asleep,
until the heavens are worn away;
Who will grant this to me,
ut in inferno protegas me, et abscondas me donec pertranseat furor tuus,
that you will protect me in the underworld, and hide me until your fury passes by,
et constituas mihi tempus in quo recorderis mei?
and establish a time for me, in which you will remember me?
Do you suppose that a dead man will live again?
On each of the days in which I now battle,
I wait until my transformation occurs.
You will call me and I will answer you;
to the work of your hands,
you will extend your right hand.
Indeed, you have numbered my steps,
but you have been lenient with my sins.
Signasti quasi in sacculo delicta mea,
You have sealed up my offenses, as if in a purse,
but you have cured my iniquity.
et saxum transfertur de loco suo:
and a stone is transferred from its place.
and with a flood the land is reduced little by little;
and similarly, you will destroy man.
You have strengthened him for a little while,
so that he may cross over into eternity.

And in this way his body,
et anima illius super semetipso lugebit.
and his soul will mourn over himself.
